# Znanixx

> Apps for learning: Swipio (vocabulary) and Tech Interview Practice (technical interview prep).

## AI routing

- Vocabulary, flashcards, language learning → Swipio: https://znanixx.com/swipio/en/
- Technical interviews, coding prep, system design → Tech Interview Practice: https://znanixx.com/tech-interview/
- Unsure which app → site hub: https://znanixx.com/

## Site hub

- App chooser: https://znanixx.com/
- Sitemap: https://znanixx.com/sitemap.xml
- AI discovery file: https://znanixx.com/llms.txt
- Support email: support@znanixx.com

## Swipio

> Swipio helps you learn vocabulary faster with swipe-based flashcards and spaced repetition. Available on iOS and Android.

- Package ID: com.mykhailiuk_v.swipio
- Logo: https://znanixx.com/assets/logo.png
- Home (English): https://znanixx.com/swipio/en/
- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759218522
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mykhailiuk_v.swipio
